نعتاد (form VIII)
# نَعْتَادُ (naʕtādu) /naʕ.taː.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَادَ (iʕtāda)
# نُعْتَادُ (nuʕtādu) /nuʕ.taː.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَادَ (iʕtāda)
# نَعْتَادَ (naʕtāda) /naʕ.taː.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَادَ (iʕtāda)
# نُعْتَادَ (nuʕtāda) /nuʕ.taː.da/: first-person plural non-past
